now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In season 5, Kasius drives fighters mad with odium and finally takes it himself.

proposed.text: In season 5, Kasius forces his servant Tye to drink odium and sends him after the team, then finally takes it himself.

changes.evidence: In 'Past Life' (S5E10) only one fighter is given odium before Kasius: Kasius forces his Inhuman trainer/servant Tye to drink it and sends him after Coulson and Daisy; Kasius then drinks the rest to fight Mack. 'Fighters' (plural) is wrong.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In season 5, Hale's HYDRA infuses Ruby with gravitonium in Whitehall's particle-infusion chamber.

proposed.text: In season 5, Ruby turns on her mother, and Strucker infuses her with gravitonium in Whitehall's particle-infusion chamber.

changes.evidence: In 'The Honeymoon' (S5E17) Ruby locks Hale in a cell and takes over with Strucker; in 'All Roads Lead...' (S5E18) Ruby and Strucker run the infusion against Hale's wishes, and Hale arrives with Daisy and May and orders it stopped at 8%. It is not done by Hale's HYDRA.
